name: SharePoint+OneDrive document-cloud graph ingestion (Outlook + personal/P2P comms STRICTLY off-graph)
description: NFRA_EXPAND Strand A (Andrew-direct 2026-06-25). Graph the SharePoint sites/libraries + OneDrive trees (the document/file clouds) into globgrph via the m365 gateway's delegated Graph API -- nodes (site/library/folder/file) + edges (contains/owned-by/has-access/shared-with) + activity metadata (lastModified/lastAccessed). HARD SCOPE BOUNDARY (Andrew, load-bearing, enforced IN CODE not by convention): OUTLOOK (email+calendar) + ALL personal/peer-to-peer comms (Teams chats/DMs) are STRICTLY OFF-GRAPH -- the ingestion never calls the mail/calendar/chat Graph surfaces. STRUCTURE/METADATA/ACTIVITY ONLY, never CONTENT (file bodies never graphed). Access-controlled sensitive sub-graph (least-priv read, not the open comp-kuzu surface). The major build; prereq for the GLOBAL heat_map (Strand C-global). Open design Q's: cadence/delta-sync, access-edge person-identity privacy, scale/granularity, same-graph-vs-federated, activity source -- in the PRD.
